title: Airworthiness Directives; MD Helicopters, LLC Helicopters
summary: The FAA is adopting a new airworthiness directive (AD) for certain MD Helicopters, LLC (MDHI) Model 369D, 369E, 369F, 369FF, 369H, and 500N helicopters.
